name: Expand Thinking Traces By Default
description: Render assistant thinking blocks fully expanded by default, without requiring ctrl+o. Forces the shouldShowFullThinking gate (isTranscriptMode||verbose) in AssistantThinkingMessage to be always truthy by swapping the minified `verbose` operand for the literal `1`, so the collapsed one-line '∴ Thinking (ctrl+o to expand)' branch is never taken and the full Markdown thinking content is shown inline.

provenance.author: aleks-apostle
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref

operations.rationale: In minified AssistantThinkingMessage (fn neH), `let w=O||T` computes shouldShowFullThinking from isTranscriptMode(O)||verbose(T); downstream `w?<full Markdown>:<collapsed one-liner>` chooses rendering. Replacing the verbose operand T with literal 1 makes w always truthy, forcing full expanded rendering with no ctrl+o. Single-char identifier -> single-char literal keeps byte length identical. The two preceding `if(!x)return null;if(y)return null;` guards (thinking-empty and hideInTranscript) plus the `,z=Y?1:0` margin computation pin the anchor uniquely.
